EN:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Hey, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}, 
I got a question for ya.

{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Ya think{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} there's some kinda greeting
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}that'll completely express my 
personality in one shot?{{TAG:0008:0005:0400150005002800}}
Totally.
Nah.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Oye, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}, quiero plantearte
una cuestión con la que espero
no invadir tu espacio vital ni nada.
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}¿Tú crees{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} que hay algún saludo
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}que refleje completamente mi
personalidad en una sola expresión?{{TAG:0008:0005:0400150005002800}}
Sin duda
Qué va...
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Hep, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}, tu m'rendrais un
service ? {{TAG:0007:0001:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Je cherche une nouvelle
façon de dire « bonjour ».
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Un truc qui crie « ME VOILÀ ! » à la
face du monde, tu vois.{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}{{TAG:0003:0017:}} Tu veux
bien m'aider ?{{TAG:0008:0005:0400150005002800}}
Facile.
Trop dur pour moi.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Ehi {{TAG:0005:0008:}}, ho una domanda
per te.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Secondo te esiste{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} un saluto
che {{TAG:0003:0017:}}si addica perfettamente
alla mia forte personalità?{{TAG:0008:0005:0400150005002800}}
Senza dubbio!
Non credo proprio.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Hey, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}, 
Hilf mir mal eben, ja?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Ich brauch 'ne Begrüßung,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} die meine
Persönlichkeit voll ausdrückt... 
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Wie isses?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Fällt dir was ein?{{TAG:0008:0005:0400150005002800}}
Aber sicher!
Nö.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Hey, {{TAG:0005:0008:}},
sana bir şey soracağım.

{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Sence{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} kişiliğimi tek seferde tam anlatan
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}öyle bir selamlaşma vardır mı?{{TAG:0008:0005:0400150005002800}}
Kesinlikle.
Yok ya.

ES:
¡Oye, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0009:}}Ya sé que es un
poquito imprevisto{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} pero creo que
necesito un cambio de presentación.
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}¿No habrá algún saludo por ahí
que modifique radicalmente{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0017:}} la
impresión que causo a los demás?{{TAG:0008:0005:0400150005002800}}
¡Por supuesto!
¿Para qué cambiar?

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Say, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
greetings are really important,
don't you think?
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}You hear a good greeting, and right
away you get an idea of what that
person's all about!
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}You think there's some kinda 
greeting that would help me make
the best impression?{{TAG:0008:0005:0400150005002800}}
Of course!
I doubt it...
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Una cosa, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
Los saludos son algo muy
importante, ¿no crees?
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Si oyes un buen saludo,
¡enseguida le pillas totalmente
el rollo a esa persona!
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}¿Crees que habrá algún tipo de
saludo que me ayude a causar
la mejor impresión posible?{{TAG:0008:0005:0400150005002800}}
¡Claro que sí!
Uf, lo dudo...
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Dis, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} La façon d'saluer
est souvent révélatrice du caractère
d'une personne, tu trouves pas ?
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Lors d'une rencontre, on dit aussi
qu'le premier contact est décisif...{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Tu t'sentirais d'attaque pour
trouver une salutation qui m'aiderait
à faire bonne impression ?{{TAG:0008:0005:0400150005002800}}
No problemo !
Mission impossible...
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Secondo te, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
quanto è importante un saluto?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Dalla maniera in cui qualcuno ti dà
la mano, per esempio, puoi capire
un sacco di cose!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Lo stesso vale per
il saluto in sé per sé, no?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Ce ne sarà uno che potrebbe
aiutarmi a dare agli altri l'idea
di me che voglio, no?{{TAG:0008:0005:0400150005002800}}
Certo!
Non credo...
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Sag mal, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
Findeste nicht auch, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}dass
Begrüßungen total wichtig sind?
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Dir kommt jemand entgegen, haut
'ne coole Begrüßung raus und du
denkst: „Wie cool ist die denn?“
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Du siehst kreativ aus, dir fällt doch
bestimmt was Gutes ein! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Na, wie
sieht's aus? {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}Haste was für mich? {{TAG:0008:0005:0400150005002800}}
Selbstverständlich!
Mir fällt nichts ein...
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Şey, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
selamlaşmalar bayağı önemli, sence
de öyle değil mi?
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}İyi bir selam duyunca insanın nasıl biri olduğunu
hemen az çok anlarsın!
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Sence bende en iyi ilk izlenimi bırakacak
bir selamlaşma var mı?{{TAG:0008:0005:0400150005002800}}
Tabii ki!
Pek sanmıyorum...
